# Preserved mod downloads

The five ZIPs in this folder are the newest supplied builds for the loader and four mods. See the [main README](../README.md) for installation, features, and source links. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers every ZIP here and in `archive/`.

`archive/` preserves older First Person and Ally Damage packages. Early First Person builds used their own `d3d9.dll`; do not install those alongside the standalone loader by overwriting its DLL. First Person 0.3.11 and 0.4.0 are plugin packages. Prefer the current packages listed in the main README.

Historical ZIPs do not imply that matching historical source revisions are available. The repository contains the current source snapshot. Newly built packages go under `build/packages/`, separate from these preserved downloads.
